comparison.objective: Orient and place five polarity-marked SMD LEDs on board footprints, then return tweezers.
comparison.physical_skill: Tweezer handling of 5 mm parts and vision-guided planar orientation without mechanical registration versus hex-bit torque and collar adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Each LED flat, within 1 mm and 10 degrees, with tweezers released in cups versus two safe repeatable dynamic stops.
comparison.reason: Both demand small-scale precision, but the mechanisms and outcomes are different: free placement and polarity matching versus mechanical tuning and locking. No spec versions exist.
